problemStatement.formal: YangMillsMillenniumProblem (G : Type*) [CompactSimpleGaugeGroup G] (𝔤 : GaugeLieAlgebra G) : ∃ qym : QuantumYangMillsTheory G 𝔤, hasSomeMassGap qym.toWightmanQFT
problemStatement.plain: MILLENNIUM PRIZE: Prove Yang-Mills theory exists in R⁴ and has positive mass gap.
whyMatters: Explains why nuclear force is short-range (mass gap implies exponential decay)
Would put quantum field theory on rigorous mathematical footing
Yang-Mills is the framework for the Standard Model of particle physics
Related to quark confinement - why quarks are never observed in isolation

open: Full Yang-Mills existence in R⁴ (requires rigorous QFT)
Mass gap Δ > 0 (the Millennium Prize problem)
Continuum limit of lattice gauge theory

knowledge.progressSummary: SURVEY COMPLETE: 9 theorems, 15 axioms, 12 structures, 7 defs, 0 sorries (407 lines). Fixed all Mathlib API compatibility issues. Proper Wightman QFT formalization with spectral mass gap definition. Builds clean.
builtItems: Part I: Spacetime and Minkowski metric with proved properties (symmetric, diagonal, trace = -2)
Part II: Gauge theory - GaugeLieAlgebra, GaugeField, GaugeTransformation with Group instance
Part III: Field strength tensor with antisymmetry proof
Part IV: Yang-Mills action with nonnegativity, instanton structure with topological charge
Part V: CovariantDerivative, SatisfiesYangMillsEquations, EnergyMomentumTensor structures
Part VI: Physical axioms - asymptotic freedom, lattice YM, Wilson area law, Bianchi identity
Part VII: WightmanQFT with NormedAddCommGroup/InnerProductSpace/CompleteSpace on Hilbert space
Part VIII: Proper spectral mass gap definition using inner products
Part IX: CompactSimpleGaugeGroup, QuantumYangMillsTheory, YangMillsMillenniumProblem statement
insights: Original file had ~10 Mathlib API compatibility bugs (mul_left_inv, Fin synthesis, LE ℂ, etc.)
inner in complex Hilbert space returns ℂ - must use RCLike.re for real comparisons
Universe inference for existential quantifier needs explicit universe annotation
GaugeLieAlgebra fields need attribute [instance] for downstream type class synthesis
@[ext] on structures is needed for Group proofs via extensionality
Proper mass gap should be spectral (∀ ψ ⊥ vacuum, Δ ≤ Re⟨Hψ,ψ⟩) not hardcoded constant
mathlibGaps: Complex.abs API changes (U(1) group instance broken)
nextSteps: Monitor Mathlib for gauge theory / QFT infrastructure
Could add 2D Yang-Mills (exactly solvable - Migdal formula)
Could add lattice gauge theory foundations (Wilson action on lattice)
Future: reduce axiom count if Mathlib adds relevant infrastructure
